PluginData.Author: LoneWolf2K
PluginData.Tooltip: Unload docks, name-tag cargo sorting ([Ore], [Parts P1], [Si] ...), status LCDs and automatic weapon ammo.
PluginData.Description:
Automatic cargo handling. Everything works by renaming blocks.
Unload docks: a connector named [Unload] takes ore and ice from docked ships, [Unload All] takes everything. Sorting: [Ore], [Ice], [Parts], [Ammo], [Tools], [Consumables], [Player], [Cells], [Misc], priority like [Ore P1], single items like [Si] or [Steel Plate]. Production output is collected. LCDs: [Cargo], [Ore], [Parts], [Power], [Damage], [Turrets], [Alerts], with full-load power and gas planning. Ammo: a Gearforge named [Make Ammo] keeps ammo for all weapons in stock.
Items only move through conveyors. Single player (multiplayer not tested yet).
Manual: https://github.com/lwolf1965/LW-Cargo-Manager/blob/main/Docs/UserManual.md Bugs and ideas: https://github.com/lwolf1965/LW-Cargo-Manager/issues
